documents.text: Verified Dense resource experiment: increasing reuse factor reduced DSP while increasing latency.
Verified MatMul timing repair: shorten the accumulation critical path and add staged pipelining before changing clock.
Verified Conv2D resource rule: avoid complete partition of large mutable feature maps; use bounded line buffers.
VivadoNotFoundError is recoverable. Preserve generated artifacts and run synthesis on a host with Vivado HLS.
ReportMissingError requires checking synthesis logs and current-run report provenance; never reuse a fixture report.
Residual elementwise branches are outside the restricted static ONNX adapter and require an unsupported boundary report.
LLM candidate verification playbook: sandbox, independent golden CSim, real CSynth, report parsing, then memory promotion.
Promote verified implementation memory only after functional verification and synthesis evidence pass their gates.
ToolTimeoutError is recoverable only for idempotent bounded retries; non-idempotent tools must not be replayed blindly.
MatMul resource optimization mentions Dense and reuse factor only as unrelated examples; this record is not Dense evidence.
Dense and MatMul reuse factor can reduce DSP; this optimization note does not apply to a ResNet residual boundary.
A generic timing warning from Vitis is not evidence for VivadoNotFoundError recovery.
